goal: Compute final fictional stream aggregation state and rejection ledger. No real streaming service is used.
rules: Process commands in listed arrival order, not sorted by event time. Partitions A and B have independent initial watermark0 and empty state.

For ingest, first check whether sample_id was previously ACCEPTED in that same partition. If yes reject as duplicate regardless of timestamp or amount. Accepted IDs remain remembered after their windows close.

If not duplicate and event time is strictly less than that partition current watermark, reject as late. Equality is accepted. A rejected sample does NOT reserve its ID, so that ID can be accepted later.
Otherwise accept the sample, remember its ID, and add amount and one count to its partition window. Width is5 ticks: start=5*floor(time/5), end=start+5, interval[start,end).

watermark updates only its named partition. Watermarks never decrease; repeated equal values are allowed. Emit and remove every existing nonempty window in that partition whose end<=new watermark, in ascending start order. Do not emit empty windows.
Append emitted windows to closed in global command/emission order. No implicit watermark advance, flush or closure occurs at end of input. An event can be late even if its window remains open.

Answer exactly watermarks,closed,open,accepted_ids,rejections. watermarks and accepted_ids are objects with exactly A and B. closed/open are lists of {partition,start,end,total,count}; open sorted by partition then start. accepted_ids values are sorted unique sample-ID lists. rejections is ordered {command,reason}, reason duplicate or late.

All integers in answers are ordinary JSON integers, never booleans/floats: times0..100, totals0..3200, counts0..32. Lists at most32 entries. Identifiers nonempty ASCII alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen1..32chars; partition A or B. Window rows have positive total/count and end=start+5.

One JSON answer line,<=8192UTF-8 bytes,depth<=32,no duplicate keys, exact required fields. One submission with no repair loop. All commands are valid and public. This tests single-answer state reasoning, not interactive streaming or real event processing.
Input bounds: at most32 commands; ingest times0..95, watermark times0..100, amounts1..100. Thus all window endpoints fit0..100.
